verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an identity provider could ship an employee app-launcher portal and browser extension. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a user-facing dashboard or extension. The cited items cover adjacent capabilities only: device-based Seamless SSO to cloud resources, admin-side management of integrated apps, and the SaaS gallery for SSO configuration.

support.subject: As an employee, one portal holds my work apps — a launcher dashboard (and browser extension) where I sign in once and reach everything I'm assigned
